direct_answer: All 10 exact pinned Paper revisions were read with zero revision drift. Preliminary disposition: 4 keep, 3 repair, 3 superseded. The transferable strengths are early measurable contracts, explicit evidence-versus-policy boundaries, and cross-lane rulings tied to concrete artifacts. The dominant failures are dense multi-kilobyte tables/lists, current-state language without durable receipts, and lane/status Papers continuing to look authoritative after a capstone or later dated status superseded their decision role.

failure_evidence.evidence: There are NO screenshots of the shipped native paper reader in this report.
failure_evidence.reader_impact: The report candidly exposes a public-reader evidence gap, but a key shipped claim remains visually under-proven and image fallbacks are already weak outside Studio.

unit_verdicts.duplicate_disposition: Supersedes the 2026-07-23 state Paper for status purposes. The capstone, charter, and wave Paper remain decision/ledger authorities; this remains a dated status snapshot.
reader_risks: Studio: preserve stable headings and collapse dense evidence tables/lists without hiding their labels.
TUI80: provide a short decision/status rail because wide tables, diagrams, images, and multi-kilobyte blocks wrap poorly.
email: send an executive extract plus a durable link; do not inline the full operational record.
public: date and freshness-label internal paths, auth topology, pricing, PR state, and live capability claims before broad publication.
CLI/API: preserve exact ids/revisions and distinguish proposed routes or target commands from shipped contracts.
unit_verdicts.rationale: Keep, date-bounded: it is the strongest status/audit artifact in the subset, provided it stays visibly stamped 2026-07-25 and links to later terminal evidence.
